title.value: Speech Self-Supervised Representation Benchmarking: Are We Doing it Right?
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the provided text.
title.quote: Speech Self-Supervised Representation Benchmarking: Are We Doing it Right?

extractions.description: This paper examines the robustness of speech self-supervised learning (SSL) benchmark results to variations in decoder architecture. It investigates the limitations of using a single decoding architecture, which could lead to oversized SSL models and inaccurate benchmarking. The study evaluates the impacts of decoder changes on model rankings across multiple tasks such as Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Automatic Speaker Verification (ASV), Emotion Recognition (ER), and Intent Classification (IC).
